title: SubsumptionReport
description: The result of walking one (consumer, provider) pair (spec.md §6). Findings are this schema's own Finding document (finding.schema.json), treated as opaque objects here and validated separately against that schema.

$schema.description: Advisory: the schema this document claims to follow. Identifier only — a reader MUST NOT fetch it.

metadata.description: How the report came to exist. Open, same placement rule as contract spec §3.2.

interactions.description: Every consumer contract interaction the checker considered, whether or not a provider shape matched it (spec.md §6.3).

matched.description: Whether a provider-shape entry was found for this interaction (spec.md §2.2). False means the interaction was never checked, distinct from a checked-and-passing interaction.

verdict.description: The Kleene conjunction of every part/slot root comparison (spec.md §6.2), or 'not-published' when 'matched' is false (spec.md §6.3) — a report-level state, not one of the walk's own three values.

findings.description: Design 2.8's own Finding documents (finding.schema.json), opaque to this schema.

Summary.title: Summary
Summary.description: Counts across the whole report, so a reader sees coverage without counting the list (the same reasoning contract spec §5.2 gives for recording the selection report rather than leaving it to be inferred).
